test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

It is nothing __else your pride which makes__ you say such a thing.

options.text: else but your pride which make
else but your pride which makes

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase "nothing else but" is the correct idiomatic expression to use here.
 
• The noun "pride" is singular, so the verb "makes" should be used instead of "make."

Therefore, the correct substitution is **else but your pride which makes**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It is nothing else but your pride which makes you say such a thing."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "else your pride that makes"** – This construction omits the necessary word "but."
 
• **Option 2: "else your pride which make"** – This option uses the incorrect verb form "make."
 
• **Option 3: "else but your pride which make"** – This option also uses the incorrect verb form "make."
